fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (INTC) declined 24% over the past month and is trading at $94.26, while AMD fell 10% and NVIDIA fell 4% during the same period, recording relatively larger declines
fields.summary_ko.1: Intel stock price rose 154% since the beginning of the year and reached $123 on September 25, but has plummeted due to concerns about credit risk from AI cloud companies and high interest rates
fields.summary_ko.2: Intel announced acquisition of Israeli quantum software company Classiq for approximately $2.3 billion, but market response was lukewarm and the key to recovering to $100 depends on Q3 2026 earnings improvement
